title: 第21章 十姐萧雅妃第22章 唐妙衣危
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
“什么？我爹没死？”
叶凡如遭雷击！
浑身剧烈颤抖，就连双手也跟着抖动，嘴唇止不住的发抖起来。
他大口喘着粗气，大脑更是嗡嗡作响：“说！叶绝云，你他妈快说啊！”
“我爹没死？这到底是怎么回事？”
“说话！！！你他妈说话啊！”
叶凡的拳头，疯狂砸在叶绝云的脸上！
皮开肉绽，叶绝云没有任何反应，彻底死绝！
平复心情后，叶凡来到唐妙衣身前，解开捆住她的绳索。
“王爷，谢谢你能来救我！”
唐妙衣身子一软，摔倒在叶凡怀里。
她很意外，她想不通堂堂镇北王居然会为了自己，一个人深夜来到大东山！
“你没泄露巴雷特的图纸，我也谢谢你！”
叶凡没有解释，他根本不知道叶绝云抓了唐妙衣！
突然。
唐妙衣的眸子一缩：“王爷，小心！”
脑海中同时传来混沌万物鼎的声音：“主人，身后！危险！”
一道黑影疾驰而来，叶凡抬起头的刹那，黑影已经冲到身前，一掌拍出！
叶凡抓住巴雷特抵挡上去，狠狠撞击在胸口，精铁铸造的枪身挡住这一掌的大不部分威力，巴雷特脱手飞出！
“是你！”

叶凡飞出去的瞬间，和黑衣老者的目光对上：“就是你来刺杀我，差点杀了我八姐！”
唐妙衣也被掀翻在地，根本站不起来。
黑衣老者一步上前，‘喀嚓’‘喀嚓’两脚，狠狠踩爆巴雷特！
这才松了一口气。
“这玩意，还真是厉害！”
黑衣老者盯着巴雷特：“居然能百米之外狙杀武王！”
“那天我站在五百米外，都差点被此物所伤！”
叶凡站起来：“我杀三个武王那次，也是你？”
黑衣老者没有回答，而是扫了一眼叶绝云的尸体，自顾自的说道：“果然是隐世家族的废物！靠丹药提升的武王，居然被另外一个废物杀了！”
“刚入门的武者，一刀杀了武王。”
“哈哈哈，你也算是临死前创造一个记录吧！”
“你，可以死了！”
黑衣老者声音极其冰冷，朝着叶凡走来！
“是谁派你来的？”
content_en:
"What? My father is not dead?"
Ye Fanru was struck by lightning!
His whole body was shaking violently, even his hands were shaking, and his lips couldn't stop trembling.
He was breathing heavily, and his brain was buzzing: "Say! Ye Jueyun, you fucking hurry up and say it!"
"My father is not dead? What is going on?"
"Speak!!! You fucking talk!"
Ye Fan's fist hit Ye Jueyun's face crazily!
The skin was torn and the flesh was torn, but Ye Jueyun didn't react at all, he was completely dead!
After calming down, Ye Fan came to Tang Miaoyi and untied the rope that bound her.
"Your Majesty, thank you for coming to save me!"
Tang Miaoyi's body softened and she fell into Mark's arms.
She was surprised. She couldn't imagine that Tangtang Zhenbei King would come to Dadong Mountain alone late at night for her own sake!
"You didn't leak Barrett's drawings, and I thank you too!"
Ye Fan did not explain. He had no idea that Ye Jueyun had captured Tang Miaoyi!
Sudden.
Tang Miaoyi's eyes narrowed: "My lord, be careful!"
At the same time, the voice of the Cauldron of Chaos came in my mind: "Master, behind you! Danger!"
A black shadow rushed towards him. The moment Ye Fan raised his head, the black shadow had already rushed in front of him and struck out with a palm!
Ye Fan grabbed Barrett and blocked it, hitting him hard on the chest. The fine iron gun body blocked most of the power of this palm, and Barrett flew out!
"It's you!"
The moment Ye Fan flew out, he met the eyes of the old man in black: "You came to assassinate me and almost killed my eighth sister!"
Tang Miaoyi was also knocked to the ground and could not stand up at all.
The old man in black stepped forward, "click" and "click" with his feet, crushing Barrett hard!
Then he breathed a sigh of relief.
"This thing is really powerful!"
The old man in black stared at Barrett: "You can actually snipe King Wu from a hundred meters away!"
"That day, I was almost injured by this thing while standing five hundred meters away!"
Ye Fan stood up: "The time I killed three Martial Kings, was it you too?"
The old man in black did not answer, but glanced at Ye Jueyun's body and said to himself: "He is indeed a trash from the hidden family! King Wu, who was promoted by pills, was actually killed by another trash!"
"A new martial artist killed the King of Martial Arts with one strike."
"Hahaha, you can set a record before you die!"
"You can die!"
The old man in black had an extremely cold voice and walked towards Mark!
"Who sent you here?"
